title: Go Mastery: Junior to Lead
description: Structured Go learning from first principles to lead-level architecture, design, and team leadership.

stages.title: Foundation
stages.description: Write, test, and run Go programs. Build confidence with language fundamentals.

categories.title: Go Setup & Toolchain
categories.description: Project setup, module system, toolchain basics, and development workflow.
categories.learning_goal: Set up a Go project, use go fmt/vet/lint, and understand the module system.

categories.title: Language Basics
categories.description: Variables, types, functions, conditionals, loops, and fundamental patterns.
categories.learning_goal: Write clear, correct Go functions that handle edge cases and use the language idiomatically.

categories.title: Data Structures
categories.description: Slices, maps, structs, pointers, and algorithmic thinking with collections.
categories.learning_goal: Use Go data structures and iteration patterns to solve problems correctly.

categories.title: Error Handling
categories.description: Return values, sentinel errors, error wrapping, custom types, and interface patterns.
categories.learning_goal: Handle errors explicitly and design clean error boundaries.

categories.title: Testing Fundamentals
categories.description: Table-driven tests, subtests, sync primitives, context, and test discipline.
categories.learning_goal: Write tests that prove behavior and catch regressions.

categories.title: AI-Augmented Development
categories.description: Using AI as a tool without losing your ability to think. Learn when to use it, when not to, and how to verify its output.
categories.learning_goal: Use AI effectively as a development partner while maintaining critical thinking and deep understanding.

stages.title: Practitioner
stages.description: Build real systems with Go. Use standard library and popular packages confidently.

categories.title: Standard Library Deep Dive
categories.description: Core packages: strings, io, bytes, sort, filepath, encoding, crypto, and more.
categories.learning_goal: Use common standard library packages with confidence and precision.

categories.title: Web & Networking
categories.description: HTTP servers, clients, middleware, routing, context propagation, and network protocols.
categories.learning_goal: Build robust web services that handle failures, timeouts, and partial states gracefully.

categories.title: Data & Serialization
categories.description: JSON, CSV, YAML, TOML, INI, config loading, and stream processing.
categories.learning_goal: Parse and generate structured data formats with proper error handling.

categories.title: Real-World Packages
categories.description: Production libraries: structured logging (slog), CLI frameworks (cobra), testing (testify), databases (pgx).
categories.learning_goal: Use popular Go packages that appear in production codebases daily.

categories.title: Concurrency Patterns
categories.description: Goroutines, channels, sync primitives, pipelines, fan-out/fan-in, and concurrent data structures.
categories.learning_goal: Build concurrent systems that stay correct under load and timing variance.

categories.title: AI at Scale
categories.description: Advanced AI collaboration patterns for complex debugging and architecture.
categories.learning_goal: Use AI as a thinking partner for complex problems without becoming dependent.

stages.title: Senior Developer
stages.description: Make architectural decisions. Build reliable, observable, performant systems.

categories.title: Architecture & Design
categories.description: Structured errors, circuit breakers, generics, websockets, SSE, and design patterns.
categories.learning_goal: Design systems with clear boundaries, resilience patterns, and clean abstractions.

categories.title: Observability
categories.description: Structured logging, metrics, tracing, and understanding runtime behavior.
categories.learning_goal: Make systems observable so you can diagnose issues in production.

categories.title: Performance
categories.description: Benchmarking, profiling with pprof, memory analysis, and optimization.
categories.learning_goal: Measure before optimizing and use profiling to find real bottlenecks.

categories.title: Security
categories.description: JWT, HMAC, password hashing, file integrity, input validation, and secure coding.
categories.learning_goal: Apply security best practices to protect data and systems.

categories.title: Advanced Data Structures
categories.description: Bloom filters, Merkle trees, heaps, graph algorithms, databases, and transactions.
categories.learning_goal: Implement and use advanced data structures for real-world problems.

stages.title: Lead Developer
stages.description: Lead teams, make technical decisions, mentor others, and ship with confidence.

categories.title: Code Quality & Review
categories.description: CLI tools, code review patterns, refactoring, and quality standards.
categories.learning_goal: Write code that is maintainable, reviewable, and production-ready.

categories.title: Build & Deploy
categories.description: Docker, CI/CD, cross-compilation, release management, and deployment.
categories.learning_goal: Ship Go applications reliably with automated build and deployment pipelines.

categories.title: Advanced Patterns
categories.description: Event sourcing, reflection, dependency injection, and architectural patterns.
categories.learning_goal: Apply advanced design patterns to complex systems.

categories.title: Leadership & Communication
categories.description: Architecture decision records, technical writing, mentoring, and team practices.
categories.learning_goal: Lead technical decisions and mentor other developers effectively.

categories.title: Bug Fix Lab
categories.description: Production debugging: reproduce, isolate, patch minimally, and confirm with regression tests.
categories.learning_goal: Develop debugging habits that save hours in production.
